scenario: A museum curator is scheduling six lectures on consecutive days of the week—Monday through Saturday—in one of two theaters: the North Theater or the South Theater. Each day has exactly one lecture. The six lecturers are Alvarez, Brenner, Cho, Diaz, Evans, and Foster. Each lecture occurs in one theater only, and each lecturer appears exactly once.

rules.note: Brenner's lecture occurs before Diaz's lecture
Cho's lecture occurs before Evans's lecture
If Foster lectures on Saturday, then both Brenner and Foster lecture in the North Theater
Alvarez and Evans both lecture in the North Theater
